title: Finite-stage raw relative gluing datum
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed poset, let $(S_\lambda)_{\lambda\in I}$ be an inverse system of schemes with affine transition morphisms, and let $S=\varprojlim_{\lambda\in I}S_\lambda$. Fix $\lambda_0\in I$ such that $S_{\lambda_0}$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and let $f\colon X\to S$ be a morphism of finite presentation. Choose the finite relative affine presentation $\mathsf R_X$ of $f$ from [def-nagata-relative-finite-affine-presentation], taking its base charts to be the inverse images of a fixed finite affine cover of $S_{\lambda_0}$ (the projection $S\to S_{\lambda_0}$ is affine, so $S$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated as that definition requires, and each base chart $V$ over an affine open $V_{\lambda_0}\subseteq S_{\lambda_0}$ is the spectrum of the colimit of the coordinate rings of the affine inverse images $V_\lambda\subseteq S_\lambda$, which is the affine setting of [def-nagata-affine-fp-descent]). For each chart algebra in $\mathsf R_X$, use [def-nagata-affine-fp-descent] and [lemma-nagata-affine-fp-descends] to choose a finite stage at which it descends; each such choice is permitted by [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data]. For each quasi-compact overlap open, use [def-nagata-qc-open-descent] and [lemma-nagata-qc-open-descends] to descend it, then transport all descended overlap opens to one common stage $\lambda_W$ above their stages using [def-nagata-basechanged-system] and [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]. Above $\lambda_W$, transport the source and target overlap data and choose one common later stage for both directions of each overlap isomorphism; descend those morphisms using [def-nagata-morphism-descent] and [lemma-nagata-morphism-descends], with each finite-stage choice again supplied by [lemma-nagata-filtered-colimit-finite-data]. Let $F$ be the finite set of all stages so obtained and define $\lambda_{\mathrm{raw}}(X/S)=u(F)$ using the selected finite upper-bound operation [def-nagata-directed-finite-upper-bound]. Transport every descended chart, overlap, and overlap morphism to $S_{\lambda_{\mathrm{raw}}}$ by the canonical comparison maps of [def-nagata-basechanged-system]. The resulting finite diagram, with its chart, overlap, and comparison data, is by definition the raw relative gluing datum $\mathsf R^{\mathrm{raw}}_{X,\lambda_{\mathrm{raw}}}$; its comparison maps are the transported maps and its typing is the functoriality of the canonical base-change maps. Like the chart descents of [def-nagata-affine-fp-descent], this datum and $\lambda_{\mathrm{raw}}(X/S)$ depend on the chosen presentation, cover, and finite-stage lifts, which are fixed once and for all; citers use it only through these fixed choices.
